record.name: MongoDB Atlas
record.one_liner: MongoDB Atlas provides a programmatic REST Administration API and an Embedding and Reranking API to manage deployments, clusters, projects, and AI capabilities.

auth.notes: Authentication methods include service account access tokens (OAuth 2.0) and API keys (HTTP Digest Authentication) for the Administration API, and Bearer token format with model API keys for the Embedding and Reranking API.

access.notes: Accounts and deployments can be created through sign up, self-service tools, and the Atlas CLI without manual review or prior sales contact.

api_surface.notes: The platform provides a REST-based Administration API, an Embedding and Reranking API, and the Atlas Go SDK.

buildability.reasoning: Self-serve account creation is available via the CLI or UI, and the REST Administration API and Embedding and Reranking API are fully documented with clear authentication methods and SDKs.

evidence.claim: The Atlas Administration API allows programmatic administration tasks outside the UI.
API authentication uses either service account access tokens (OAuth 2.0) or API keys (HTTP Digest Authentication).
The Embedding and Reranking API provides programmatic access through a RESTful interface using Bearer token authentication.
The Atlas Go SDK is provided to interact with the Atlas Administration API.
Users can set up accounts and create local or cloud MongoDB Atlas deployments via the Atlas CLI.
